description:
Steer Astro creates accurate personalized Vedic Birth Charts, Planetary Transits, Dasha periods, and Panchang, enabling you to get Vedic Astrology insights directly from ChatGPT.

Sign in to Steer Astro to connect and create your profile once, then ask questions about:

Your Birth Chart (Kundali)
- Positions of all 9 planets including Sun, Moon, Mars, and more
- Your rising sign and planetary house placements
- Key indicators revealing your soul's purpose and relationships

Life Timing with Dasha Periods
- Your current planetary period and what it means for you
- When shifts in career, relationships, or personal growth are likely
- How long your current phase will last

Daily Planning with Panchang
- Today's lunar day, nakshatra, and auspicious yogas
- Best windows for important activities
- Times to avoid like Rahu Kaal

Planetary Transits
- How current planetary movements affect your chart
- What's influencing your energy and opportunities right now

Ask questions like:
- "When will I get married?"
- "Is this a good time to change jobs?"
- "Is today a good day to go on a date?"
- "What are my top 3 strengths?"
- "What patterns do I keep repeating?"
- "When is a good time to start my business?"

All calculations use the Swiss Ephemeris for astronomical precision. Your profile is securely stored - create it once and get personalized insights anytime. You can always edit your profile by asking - "Help me edit my profile."
